claims.claim: Added a strict versioned selection contract that independently authenticates allowlisted Human GitHub Issue provenance and binds exact TASK, acceptance, candidate, RUN and semantic source identities.
The existing Runtime writer persists only an immutable selection using Git CAS, currentness checks and identical replay; divergent, stale and competing selections are rejected.

The existing read-only reader consumes authenticated selection without a public review TASK selector, retains complete canonical Reviewer/Publisher lineage requirements, and fails closed on unavailable or conflicting subjects.
Selection validation requires an actual mapping delta and explicit modification scope; changed contracts require modification scope while unchanged contracts may use inspection scope.

Added synthetic authenticated-selection and separate published-review lineage fixtures, including spoofing, selector swaps, stale refs, conflicting replay, incomplete review, contract scope and read-only side-effect counterexamples.

Existing lifecycle decoding and dispatch branches remain in place; selection rejects lifecycle credentials and emits no publication or repair wakeup outputs, with compatibility regression fixtures added.
Documentation and frozen typed outputs distinguish authenticated Human intent, source consistency, review authority, canonical proof, future admission, opt-in and inactive production status.
The committed implementation changes exactly the nine authorized paths, reuses existing authority owners and leaves ROADMAP unchanged.
